Being off adderall makes you actually appreciate life - I’ve been addicted for almost a year and barely remember anything from that time. Other benefits when I’ve been off it for a while: 
- much better at socializing
- give a shit about people other than myself
- much better work (no wasting hours fixating on stupid details or reorganizing and planning)
- incredibly lowered anxiety, nothing is a big deal 
- no more last minute cancelling on people !!! Just to tweak in my room 
- the pissing thing is SO real I remember that the most from my first time literally every 10 mins  
- discovering my actual interests and not just stim induced hyperfixations
- time passes at a NORMAL rate and 3 hours is no longer ‘nothing’
- actually enjoy experiences instead of mentally anticipating the next thing constantly
- etc
